title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand NCCL's purpose: optimized primitives for inter-GPU communication supporting all-reduce, all-gather, reduce, broadcast, and reduce-scatter across PCIe, NVLink, NVswitch, InfiniBand, and TCP/IP.

title: Public API — nccl.h
description: Understand the core public interface. nccl.h defines all collective operations (ncclAllReduce, ncclBroadcast, etc.), communicator types (ncclComm_t), and error codes that users interact with.

title: Initialization Flow
description: Follow init.cc to understand how NCCL bootstraps: device detection → topology discovery → transport selection → channel creation. This is the entry point of every NCCL application.

title: Graph & Routing — Topology Discovery
description: The graph module analyzes GPU topology (NVLink, PCIe hierarchy) and computes optimal ring/tree routing paths. This is critical for performance — it decides how data flows between GPUs.

title: Transport Layer Architecture
description: NCCL's transport abstraction supports multiple backends: NVLink (p2p), Shared Memory (shm), InfiniBand (net_ib), and TCP/IP. Each transport implements the same interface but optimized for its hardware.

title: Device Kernels — Collective Algorithms
description: The GPU-side implementation of all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter via ring and tree algorithms. These kernels run on the GPU and handle the actual data movement and reduction.

title: Scheduler — Execution Pipeline
description: The scheduler orchestrates collective operations across multiple channels and transports, managing work queues and ensuring efficient GPU utilization.

title: Plugin System — Extensibility
description: NCCL's plugin architecture allows custom network backends (net), tuners for performance optimization, profilers for debugging, and GIN support. Understand how to extend NCCL.

title: Contrib Extensions
description: Explore experimental features from the community: nccl_ep (enhanced point-to-point), nccl_m2n (many-to-many communication), nccl_ubx, and checkpoint support.

title: Build System
description: Understand the CMake + Makefile build system that compiles NCCL for different GPU architectures and produces distributable packages (deb, rpm, tarball).
